people.name: Chaos
people.description: Primordial void, first being in Greek cosmogony

people.name: Gaia
people.description: Primordial Earth goddess

people.name: Uranus
people.description: Primordial sky god, consort of Gaia

people.name: Cronus
people.description: Titan king, father of the Olympian gods

people.name: Rhea
people.description: Titaness, mother of the Olympians

people.name: Zeus
people.description: King of the gods, ruler of sky and thunder

people.name: Iapetus
people.description: Titan, father of Atlas

people.name: Clymene
people.description: Oceanid, mother of Atlas

people.name: Leto
people.description: Titaness, mother of Apollo and Artemis

people.name: Coeus
people.description: Titan, father of Leto

people.name: Phoebe
people.description: Titaness, mother of Leto

people.name: Hera
people.description: Queen of the gods, wife of Zeus

people.name: Atlas
people.description: Titan who holds up the sky

people.name: Apollo
people.description: God of music, prophecy and the sun

people.name: Artemis
people.description: Goddess of the hunt and the moon

people.name: Ares
people.description: God of war

people.name: Athene
people.description: Goddess of wisdom and war, born from Zeus

people.name: Aphrodite
people.description: Goddess of love and beauty

people.name: Dione
people.description: Goddess, mother of Aphrodite in Homer

people.name: Alcmena
people.description: Mother of Heracles by Zeus

people.name: Amphitryon
people.description: Theban hero, husband of Alcmena

people.name: Antiope
people.description: Theban princess, mother of Amphion and Zethus

people.name: Asopus
people.description: River god, father of Antiope

people.name: Amphion
people.description: Theban king, musician, builder of Thebes' walls

people.name: Arcas
people.description: Eponym of Arcadia, son of Zeus and Callisto

people.name: Callisto
people.description: Nymph, mother of Arcas

people.name: Æsculapius
people.description: God of medicine, son of Apollo

people.name: Achilles
people.description: Greatest Greek warrior at Troy

people.name: Oceanus
people.description: Titan of the encircling river-sea.

people.name: Demeter
people.description: Goddess of grain and harvest.

people.name: Hephæstus
people.description: God of fire and the forge.

people.name: Hermes
people.description: Messenger god, son of Zeus and Maia.

people.name: Dionysus
people.description: God of wine, son of Zeus and Semele.

people.name: Hercules
people.description: Greatest Greek hero, son of Zeus and Alcmene.

people.name: Helen
people.description: Daughter of Zeus, wife of Menelaus, cause of Trojan War.

people.name: Castor
people.description: One of the Dioscuri, brother of Helen.

people.name: Menelaus
people.description: King of Sparta, husband of Helen.

people.name: Leda
people.description: Spartan queen, mother of Helen and the Dioscuri.

people.name: Tyndareus
people.description: King of Sparta, husband of Leda.

people.name: Atreus
people.description: King of Mycenae, father of Agamemnon and Menelaus.

people.name: Alcmene
people.description: Mother of Hercules by Zeus.

people.name: Maia
people.description: Pleiad, mother of Hermes.

people.name: Semele
people.description: Theban princess, mother of Dionysus.

people.name: Lycaon
people.description: Arcadian king turned into a wolf.

people.name: Poseidon
people.description: God of the sea and earthquakes

people.name: Proserpine
people.description: Daughter of Demeter, queen of the underworld

people.name: Danae
people.description: Princess of Argos, mother of Perseus

people.name: Perseus
people.description: Hero who slew Medusa, founder of Mycenae

people.name: Pollux
people.description: Divine twin, one of the Dioscuri

people.name: Tantalus
people.description: King punished in the underworld, father of Pelops

people.name: Pelops
people.description: Hero who gave his name to the Peloponnese

people.name: Hippodamia
people.description: Daughter of Oenomaus, wife of Pelops

people.name: Œnomaus
people.description: King of Pisa, killed in chariot race by Pelops

people.name: Agamemnon
people.description: King of Mycenae, leader of the Greeks at Troy

people.name: Clytemnestra
people.description: Wife of Agamemnon, daughter of Tyndareus

people.name: Orestes
people.description: Son of Agamemnon who avenged his father

people.name: Tisamenus
people.description: Son of Orestes, king of Argos and Sparta

people.name: Laius
people.description: King of Thebes, father of Oedipus

people.name: Jocasta
people.description: Queen of Thebes, mother and wife of Oedipus

people.name: Œdipus
people.description: King of Thebes who solved the Sphinx's riddle

people.name: Polynices
people.description: Son of Oedipus, led the Seven against Thebes

people.name: Thersander
people.description: Theban king, son of Polynices

people.name: Aegeus
people.description: King of Athens, father of Theseus

people.name: Aethra
people.description: Princess of Troezen, mother of Theseus

people.name: Theseus
people.description: Athenian hero who slew the Minotaur

people.name: Pandion
people.description: Legendary king of Athens, father of Aegeus

people.name: Aeacus
people.description: King of Aegina, judge of the dead

people.name: Telamon
people.description: King of Salamis, son of Aeacus, father of Ajax

people.name: Phocus
people.description: Son of Aeacus, eponym of Phocis

people.name: Phoroneus
people.description: Early king of Argos, first man in some accounts

people.name: Niobe
people.description: Daughter of Phoroneus, mother of Argus and Pelasgus in some accounts

people.name: Pelasgus
people.description: Ancestor of the Pelasgians, early king of Arcadia

people.name: Sisyphus
people.description: Founder-king of Corinth, punished in Tartarus

people.name: Œneus
people.description: King of Calydon, father of Meleager and Deianira

people.name: Priam
people.description: Last king of Troy

people.name: Neoptolemus
people.description: Son of Achilles, slayer of Priam

people.name: Peleus
people.description: King of Phthia, father of Achilles

people.name: Temenus
people.description: Heraclid, king of Argos

people.name: Aristomachus
people.description: Heraclid, father of Temenus

people.name: Heracles
people.description: Greatest Greek hero, ancestor of the Heraclids

relationships.note: Hesiod's account; Gaia also said to be self-born
Born from Zeus's head; Metis was her mother
Hesiod has her born from Uranus's severed parts
Some say Nycteus was her father
Hesiod says Hera alone bore him
Zeus and Leda; Tyndareus sometimes father
Often son of Tyndareus; Pollux son of Zeus
Callisto usually daughter of Lycaon; Zeus link removed
Other versions make her daughter of Nycteus or Ceteus
Some accounts make Plisthenes the father
Some say Aegeus was son of Scyrius
Some say Poseidon was the father
Zeus and Niobe; Arcadian tradition varies
Aristomachus was a descendant of Heracles, not a son
